# Royal Plaza Hotels Dhanaura

> Luxury hotel on Sadhaura Road, VPO Dhanaura, Barara, Ambala, Haryana. AC rooms, banquet hall, restaurant, swimming pool, and parking for families, couples, travelers, and event guests.
